remarks: Just Perfect! Nestled in the heart of the prestigious Tokeneke Association, 10 Winding Lane is a masterfully remodeled smart home, designed for effortless luxury and year-round comfort. Freshly painted and meticulously maintained, this turnkey 4-bedroom, 3 1/2-bath retreat blends timeless elegance with modern convenience. At the heart of the home, the gourmet DEANE-designed kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring premium appliances, marble countertops, a spacious island, and exquisite craftsmanship. French doors from both the kitchen and living room open to expansive deck and lushly landscaped gardens, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. For year-round enjoyment, a three-season screened-in porch with a wood-burning fireplace offers the perfect setting-whether for crisp autumn evenings or breezy summer nights. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite is a private sanctuary, complete with his-and-hers walk-in closets and a spa-inspired natural stone bath, featuring heated floors, a soaking tub and a spacious walk-in shower. Outside, a picturesque natural landscape and a charming stone pathway enhance the home's appeal. Move right in and embrace the unparalleled lifestyle of living in Tokeneke.
